literal: mid-afternoon, from the Islamic prayer period, used generally for afternoon
the hot dry season before the rains -- Hausa lands have no cold-to-warm spring; mapped by calendar position
the rainy season -- mapped by calendar position, not temperature
the harvest season -- mapped by calendar position
the cold harmattan season -- the one traditional season that genuinely matches its English name

text: Agogon Kiswahili yana farawa daga fitowar rana, sa'o'i shida daga agogon waya: saa moja = 7:00, saa sita = 12:00, saa kumi = 16:00. Ku fadi lambobin ko ku tambaya da saa ngapi za kizungu domin sanin lokacin turawa (na yamma).
